exceptions.justification: Version pinned by Mojang's 1.21.5 launcher manifest and resolved onto the minecraftLibraries/minecraftClientLibraries classpaths and their derived compile, runtime, and GameTest classpaths; not project-upgradeable without diverging from that manifest and regenerating mod/gradle.lockfile and mod/gradle/verification-metadata.xml. The deeply-nested-input StackOverflowError requires attacker-controlled JSON reaching a Jackson parser; this project constructs no Jackson parser, and its protocol-v2 frames are parsed by the mod's own bounded reader over a loopback-only authenticated bridge.

The bypass requires a NonBlockingJsonParser fed attacker-controlled chunks; jackson-core is present only as a transitive Minecraft/MSAL client library and this project instantiates no Jackson parser.

Triaged 2026-10-24 for the private companion candidate; exact locked package/version and listed classpaths only. Requires createParser(DataInput). Re-triage if callers/configuration change. Evidence: docs/security/JVM_TRIAGE_2026-10-24.md. Upstream fixes for this coordinate: 2.18.11, 2.21.7, 2.22.3.
